correct_answer: Apply 2020 TV Agreement rates to episodes 1-7 and 2025 interim agreement rates to episodes 8-10, based on actual photography start dates and the signatory filing
rationale: The correct answer requires synthesizing the Labor Relations transition matrix (which establishes the rule: signatory filing covers pre-Jul 1 episodes, but episodes with photography starting on/after Jul 1 trigger interim rates), Karen Lu's email (which confirms episode-by-episode photography start dates — Ep 7 started Jun 22, before the cutoff, while Eps 8-10 started Jul 14+), and the Slack thread (which raised but never resolved the question). Answer A is wrong because RightsLine has incorrect agreement data — the 2023 agreement was never the governing document; the valid filing was under 2020. Answer C applies the blanket signatory rule without the episode-level exception from the transition matrix. Answer D misreads the cutoff — it splits at episodes 7-10 assuming the back half of production, but Ep 7 actually started photography on Jun 22 (before the Jul 1 threshold), which is only confirmed in Karen's email. The critical signal lives in an email that received no reply and was never escalated back to the Slack thread where the question originated.
